category.name: Marble Static
category.description: Greek and Roman sculpture colliding with screen-age residue: RGB splits, scan lines, chrome, sunset grids and torn paper. Use it for archives, music, culture and product launches that want myth and nostalgia in the same frame.

designs.name: Kouros Signal
designs.summary: A cold stone page with a giant Bodoni headline and a marble bust sliced, shifted and fringed in cyan and magenta, framed by a Greek key border.

references.title: Spectra: where art meets digital innovation (classical sculpture concept)
Vaporwave style guide: Roman busts, VHS scanlines

designs.how_to_build: Build the bust as one inline SVG group (shapes plus an feTurbulence marble filter), then stack it: two colour-matrixed copies offset left and right with mix-blend-mode multiply, and several clipPath bands that repaint the background and redraw the bust shifted sideways. Add coloured streak rects and vertical bars for pixel-sorting. Pair a very heavy high-contrast serif with a mono caption face, and finish with a repeating-linear-gradient scanline layer and an SVG grain overlay.

designs.name: Lethe FM
designs.summary: A neon sunset with a slit sun, a tilted teal grid floor and a lilac-to-pink profile bust on a plinth, with a glass player window floating in front.

references.title: Retro and old-computer UI collection (vaporwave, holographic)
Vaporwave web design: grids, busts, sunset gradients
Daplanks shots, vaporwave and glitch art

designs.how_to_build: Layer a multi-stop sky gradient, an SVG sun with a mask of horizontal black bars that grow thicker toward the horizon, and a floor div carrying a two-direction line grid under perspective(380px) rotateX(64deg) with a teal drop-shadow glow. Draw the bust as SVG paths filled with a three-stop teal-lilac-pink gradient and generate hair curls with a small loop. Use a wide display face with a gradient text fill, then add a blurred backdrop-filter window and a scanline overlay.

designs.name: Pearlpod Chrome
designs.summary: A bubbly pearl-blue launch page: liquid-chrome wordmark, glossy pill buttons, orbit rings, chrome orbs and a taped lime ticker around a pocket music player.

references.title: Y2K aesthetic for web design: chrome, gradients, bubbles
15 classic 90s websites and modern sites keeping the look alive

designs.how_to_build: Fake chrome with background-clip:text and a hard-stop vertical gradient that goes white, sky blue, navy, then jumps back to light blue at 50 percent, plus a dark text-stroke and stacked drop-shadows. Build glossy buttons from a split gradient with a sharp midpoint, a white border and inset shadows. Spheres are radial gradients with an off-centre white highlight and a bright rim. Rotate the product SVG, ring it with a gradient-stroked ellipse and tilt a navy ticker band -2 degrees.

designs.name: Cut-Out Pantheon
designs.summary: A kraft-paper desk with a ransom-note headline, a torn card holding a headless marble torso, a column, an all-seeing eye on a blue moon, tape, stamps and a price tag.

references.title: Risograph and zine web aesthetics: grain, overlays, misregistration
Secret Riso Club on It's Nice That
Spectra: classical sculpture meets digital collage

designs.how_to_build: Generate the headline from JavaScript: each letter becomes a tile with its own font, paper colour, rotation, vertical nudge and a slightly jagged clip-path polygon. For torn paper, run SVG shapes through an feTurbulence plus feDisplacementMap filter and add a hard feDropShadow. Shade statues with a rotated dot pattern fill at partial opacity, give cut-outs a thick white stroke, and finish with semi-transparent tape rectangles and a textPath stamp.
